description: Places an order to license one AREMES 3D model (the GT, the Sport Bike, the V-Twin Cruiser, the three Interdimensional Suits, the Parts in the Round, two relief sculptures and the sixteen AREMES Furniture pieces) as GLB and USDZ files, for the person or business you act for. Returns the order number, the total and a Stripe checkout link for the licensee to pay by card; nothing is charged until it is paid. The order is governed by the AREMES 3D Model License (https://aremes-enterprises.com/vehicles/license/) and is accepted only when agree is true, meaning the licensee has agreed to it.

agree.description: True only if the licensee read and agreed to the AREMES 3D Model License.

term.description: 1m = one month ($25), 1y = one year ($150), own = perpetual ($450). A furniture piece (sofa, chair, table, lamp, planter, bench, desk, deskchair, diningtable, diningchair, bed, nightstand, sofa-two, chair-two, table-two, planter-two) has two terms only: 1y = one-year license ($50), own = perpetual license ($150). Every term is a non-exclusive license, never a sale of the design.
